scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward, 33 recoverable failures. All operators are the model's own trained modules: sem_* use the trained contrastive align projections (applied to the query, or to the mask-pooled region feature); camap_* use the trained sampling language-point projections. Region features are sigmoid-mask-weighted poolings of the final encoder inst_feats. Applying the vision projection to a region feature is out-of-distribution, so a positive result is a necessary-condition probe, not an admissible design; a negative result across ALL variants would instead show that region language evidence is insufficient. Ranking designs remain a closed direction. No model, novelty, efficacy or resource admission.
